description: For bounded products, \(B(\bar x,0)=1\) and \(B(\bar x,b+1)=B(\bar x,b)f(\bar x,b)\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PrimitiveRecursion.boundedProduct_equations.{u_1} {α : Type u_1} (f : α → ℕ → ℕ) (x : α)
  (b : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PrimitiveRecursion.boundedProduct f x 0 = 1 ∧
    Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PrimitiveRecursion.boundedProduct f x (b + 1) =
      Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PrimitiveRecursion.boundedProduct f x b * f x b
